details.presidential_2008: Obama 69,498,516 (52.93%) minus McCain 59,948,323 (45.65%) of 131,313,820 total votes = +7.273. FEC, Federal Elections 2008, 2008 Presidential Popular Vote Summary (p. 5): https://www.fec.gov/resources/cms-content/documents/federalelections2008.pdf . Saved as raw/fec-federalelections2008.pdf
details.generic_ballot_2010: RealClearPolitics 'RCP Average' for the 2010 Generic Congressional Vote, 10/25 - 10/31: Republicans 50.7, Democrats 41.3 = -9.4 (R+9.4). Read from the Wayback Machine capture of 2011-04-30 20:14 UTC: https://web.archive.org/web/20110430201418id_/http://www.realclearpolitics.com:80/epolls/other/2010_generic_congressional_vote-2171.html . The RCP page was free (not paywalled); RCP itself was not fetched (it blocks scripted fetches). This is a post-election capture; the page's 'RCP Average' row is the final pre-election average (the polls in it end 10/31) and the page's separate 'Final Results' row reads Republicans 51.6, Democrats 44.8 (R+6.8). No pre-election capture of this page exists in the Wayback CDX index. Saved as raw/rcp-2010-generic-ballot-wayback-20110430201418.html. Used because it is the only final generic-ballot AVERAGE read from a free page in this collection; see the alternatives object for what was not retrieved.

generic_ballot_2010_alternatives.Pollster.com / HuffPost Pollster: not retrieved. The Wayback capture of the HuffPost Pollster '2010 U.S. House: National Generic Ballot' table (https://web.archive.org/web/20111130154412id_/http://www.huffingtonpost.com/pollster/pollster/10USHouseGenBallot.html , saved as raw/huffpost-pollster-10USHouseGenBallot-wayback-20111130154412.html) lists the individual polls through 10/29-11/1/10 but not the trend estimate, which was drawn in a Flash chart whose data file is not archived; the older pollster.com page has no capture after 2010-08-17. The commonly cited final Pollster estimate (about R+6 to R+7) is NOT verified here.
generic_ballot_2010_alternatives.FiveThirtyEight (2010): not used: in 2010 FiveThirtyEight was hosted at nytimes.com, which is metered/paywalled; not fetched.
generic_ballot_2010_alternatives.Wikipedia: the pages 'Nationwide opinion polling for the 2010 United States House of Representatives elections' and '... 2010 United States congressional elections' do not exist (missing in the API on 2026-10-28); the 2010 House elections article links Pollster.com and RCP but states no final average.
generic_ballot_2010_alternatives.RealClearPolitics final result line (not: the same RCP capture shows 'Final Results' R 51.6, D 44.8 = -6.8, RCP's own national House tally; recorded for reference only.

details.congressional_2010: 50 states only: D 38,856,675 (44.706%), R 44,746,176 (51.483%), other 3,311,242, total 86,914,093 = -6.776. Derived from the FEC general-election table '2010 Votes Cast for the U.S. House of Representatives by Party' (Federal Elections 2010, p. 9) by removing the AS, DC, GU, MP and VI delegate rows. The FEC total including delegates (D 39,038,317, R 44,763,085, other 3,332,746) gives -6.570. FEC: https://www.fec.gov/resources/cms-content/documents/federalelections2010.pdf , saved as raw/fec-federalelections2010.pdf
details.congressional_2010_clerk: Clerk of the House, Statistics of the Congressional Election of November 2, 2010, national recapitulation (50 states): R 44,593,666, D 38,854,459, total 86,784,957 = -6.613. The Clerk credits fusion-line votes (NY Conservative, Working Families, Independence; CT Working Families; SC Working Families) to those parties rather than to the D/R candidate, which lowers both major-party totals, and some state totals differ from FEC for reasons not traced here (e.g. Indiana: FEC D 740,342 / R 1,087,586 / total 1,931,429 vs Clerk D 679,462 / R 972,671 / total 1,747,720; MEDSL's Indiana rows agree with the Clerk). The FEC 50-state figure is the headline value, as in the siblings. Source: https://history.house.gov/Institution/Election-Statistics/2010election/ (serves the PDF), saved as raw/clerk-statistics-2010-election.pdf

district_sources.presidential_margins_on_2010_lines: Daily Kos Elections data published by The Downballot, '2008 results according to the district lines used in 2006, 2008, and 2010', linked from https://www.the-downballot.com/p/the-downballots-calculations-of-presidential (page saved as raw/downballot-presidential-calculations-page.html); Google Sheet 1l7W130tPRF6dQ4JoqlQJSJexnEg4rZct-7kwDXqgoLE, tabs 'Results' (gid 429358610, integer shares, all 435; raw/downballot-pres2008-on-2010-lines.csv), 'Vote totals' (gid 391673686, filled only for AK through MA plus the at-large states; raw/downballot-pres2008-on-2010-lines-votetotals.csv) and 'Info' (gid 1430486288; raw/downballot-pres2008-on-2010-lines-info.csv). For the states the Vote totals tab leaves blank, the per-state worksheets of the Swing State Project's 'Presidential Results by Congressional District, 2000-2008' (the predecessor of Daily Kos Elections; page read from the free Wayback capture https://web.archive.org/web/2011id_/http://www.swingstateproject.com:80/diary/4161/presidential-results-by-congressional-district-20002008 , saved as raw/ssp-presidential-results-by-cd-2000-2008-wayback.html) were exported as CSV from Google Sheets via their original keys (https://docs.google.com/spreadsheet/ccc?key=<key>&output=csv) and saved under raw/ssp-2008-state-sheets/. Cross-check: the DKE 2012 old-vs-new comparison sheet 1JEl9zKk-6RYKxcBVTutQzwdy1tgTc9AOrKEJOs_T1zY (linked from https://www.dailykos.com/stories/2012/1/13/1054554/), saved as raw/downballot-pres2008-old-and-new-lines-2012-comparison.csv; its 'Predecessor Districts' columns repeat the Results-tab integers.
